decisions.reason: The relaunch SEO service sits close to the core shop-relaunch business, costs little to keep on the website, and still had its own page in its second year, so the option is worth more than its carrying cost while demand from relaunch projects unfolds.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 and their prospects are still unresolved, while keeping them costs little because they draw on existing marketing expertise, so holding the option is justified.
